newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian police seize cocaine, arrest three.
newsitem.headline: Italian police seize cocaine, arrest three.

text.p: Italian police said on Saturday they had seized 60 kg (132 lbs) of cocaine and arrested three people, including an Argentine man, charged with international drug trafficking.
Some $240,000 worth of Italian currency was also seized, police added.
They said the cocaine, with an estimated street value of around $26 million dollars, was believed to have arrived in Europe via the German port of Hamburg.
